zh.headline: 买回家的食物，后来去了哪里？

en.headline: What happens to the food we bring home?

zh.headline: 有些食物，只是慢慢被忘在冰箱里。

en.headline: Sometimes food simply gets lost at the back of the fridge.

zh.eyebrow: 澳大利亚家庭 · 年度调查估计
zh.body: 有 35 岁以下成员的家庭，每年约丢弃这么多食物。

en.body: Households with someone under 35 discard about this much food each year.

zh.eyebrow: 同一调查群体 · 年度估计
zh.body: 这些被丢弃食物的估计价值。

en.body: The estimated value of food discarded by these households.

zh.headline: 购物前没查看家里有什么，或计划改变，都可能让食物被忘记。

en.headline: Skipping a fridge check or changing plans can leave food forgotten.

zh.headline: 下次购物前，先看看家里已有的食物。

en.headline: Before your next shop, check what you already have.
